title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. AWARD a Contract to Merriwether & Williams Insurance Services (MWIS), a HUB International Company, for…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0087, Contract]
[FINANCE, BUDGET, AND AUDIT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:

A.	AWARD a Contract to Merriwether & Williams Insurance Services (MWIS), a HUB International Company, for administration of Metro’s Contractor Development and Bonding Program (CDBP), through a piggyback procurement using the City of Los Angeles’ (City) Contract No. C-204277, in a Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of $2,883,635.08 for the period December 4, 2026, through December 3, 2029; 

B.	EXECUTE a no-cost Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the City of Los Angeles (Attachment A) for Metro’s participation in the City’s Contractor Development and Bonding Program; and

C.	APPROVE a separate allocation NTE $450,000 over the proposed contract term, with an annual amount NTE $150,000, to cover loan-related fees under the Contractor Finance Assistance Program (CFAP) for eligible small businesses performing on Metro contracts. These fees are excluded from the MWIS contract price, which funds the CDBP program administration.
